newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crop damage from Australian storm seen slight.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crop damage from Australian storm seen slight.

text.p: Initial inspections indicate there was little crop damage in the Armindale region of New South Wales from a hail storm on Sunday, the New South Wales Grains Board said on Monday.
"Early reports have indicated little or no damage to crops," the board's regional director in Tamworth, Chris Ward, told Reuters. "Frosts have been patchy with no major damage."
However, Ward said later that heavy damage has been reported in the Gurley wheat-growing region north west of Armidale.
The inital inspections cover an area extending from the town of Dubbo to the Queensland border, Ward said.
Armidale, mainly a grazing area, bore the brunt of the 40 minute-storm, with an estimated 200 homes there wrecked by winds reaching 160 km per hour, Ward said.
The storm struck about (0530 GMT) 3:30 p.m. on Sunday.
Ward said growers were bracing for possible further storm conditions later on Monday.
